product.title: Simulation Room — Westbrook Wolves
product.summary: Ten turns, each mapped to one named economics concept, ending in a graded report card.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students manage a team through ten turns from a starting cap position, each turn tied to a specific concept — scarcity, opportunity cost, incentives, supply and demand, market failure, externalities, price elasticity, comparative advantage, budget deficit, and short against long term. Each choice carries a cap and wins impact and is judged sound or unsound, producing a GM score and a read on their spending pattern.

studentDataProfile.notes: Requires a student account and Track 101 Module 2 completion. Turn state persists server-side in a simulations table. Descriptive only.

governance.maturityBasis: Complete with server-authoritative scoring and a graded report card. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: The route exists in a deployed site, but it is gated behind a student account and prior module completion, so the experience itself could not be reached and verified.
knownBlockers: Gated behind a student account and prior module completion, so it cannot be handed to a class as a link.

provenance.evidence: BOW-WEBSITE/lib/sim-game.ts defines the team, a starting cap and ten turns, each mapped to a named concept; app/simulation-room/page.tsx requires the student role plus Track 101 Module 2 completion.
